artefact: Prospective Evaluation — Window 2 — completed evidence archive

code_provenance.derivation_from_window_1: Each Window 2 script was derived from the corresponding archived Window 1 script by targeted substitution only: the scratchpad path in all six, plus the Window 2 boundary in 01_load_ledger.py. Diffed against the Window 1 originals, the count of non-path, non-date differences is ZERO in all six files.
code_provenance.methodology_unchanged: No methodological logic, definition, threshold, exclusion, horizon, cohort or reporting rule was changed.
code_provenance.statement: Unlike Window 1, the six Window 2 scripts were written to disk FIRST and executed from those files. The files archived under code/ ARE the file objects the interpreter opened. The SHA-256 values in this manifest are of those exact files. This closes the Window 1 caveat, in which the archived code/ files were verbatim transcriptions of inline heredocs rather than the executed file objects.
code_provenance.window_1_code_verified: All 7 Window 1 code artefacts were re-hashed and matched window_1/MANIFEST.json before derivation.

evidence_window_evaluated.bar_gap_points: 138 total, exactly 2 per symbol, a direct consequence of the two missing ledger slots shifting the 12-slot bar-selection stride. Affected anchors fail forward coverage and are excluded by the frozen exclusion rule.
evidence_window_evaluated.gap_handling: The two known missing ledger slots remained missing. They were NOT backfilled, repaired or interpolated. An omitted slot is simply absent from the denominator. Evaluation used 2,014 of the expected 2,016 slots.

excluded_from_archive: AWS session credentials, assume.sh and db.sh (contains a Secrets Manager ARN) are deliberately not archived.

findings.attenuation_sits_in_the_warning_arm: NORMAL-anchor incidence was near-identical across windows (2%/60m 15.29 -> 15.44; 1%/60m 44.38 -> 46.61). The attenuation therefore comes from the warning arm, not from a shifted baseline.
findings.cascade_pressure_small_sample: The CASCADE_PRESSURE split rests on 31-33 episodes. A single episode moves any cell by roughly 3.2 percentage points. No claim rests on it.
findings.direction_replicated: All 16 predeclared cells of the overall grid show positive lift in BOTH windows. Relative incidence exceeded 1.0 in every overall cell of both windows. The sign of the effect replicated without exception.
findings.magnitude_did_not_replicate: Measured lift fell in 15 of 16 overall cells in Window 2, in several cells by more than half (2%/60m +32.49pp -> +16.93pp; 3%/60m +19.36pp -> +8.03pp).
findings.majors_unstable: Majors disagree in direction across 6 of 16 cells on 88-94 episodes. No stable pattern across the two windows.
findings.no_accuracy_figure: Layer 1 and Layer 2 are reported separately and are not combined. No cell was selected as preferred. No statistical test beyond the four predeclared descriptive figures was applied.
findings.summary: Two windows are two observations. The direction replicated; the magnitude did not.
findings.two_windows_cannot_distinguish: Two windows cannot distinguish between a genuinely smaller effect, sensitivity to market regime, and ordinary sampling variation. Nothing here establishes which.

known_cosmetic_artefacts_not_corrected: 02_layer1_and_anchors.py prints the literal label 'market states (of 2016 rows)'. The label is stale for Window 2; the arithmetic correctly divides by the actual row count 2014 (QUIET 1195/2014 = 59.335%). Not edited, because editing would break functional identity with Window 1.
03_build_price_series.py reports 138 one-minute gap points, exactly 2 per symbol, caused by the two missing ledger slots. Window 1 had none.

ordering_attestation.statement: The full verification chain was completed BEFORE any outcome was opened: Protocol v1.0 hash, Amendment 1 hash, Window 2 declaration and boundary match, Window 1 computation artefacts, then Window 2 ledger data. Step 1 window integrity was completed before any Layer 2 outcome was computed.

read_only_attestation.canon_surfaces: The clone holds a single table, public_state_log, under schema_version canon2. There is no canon1 table in this database. No canon surface was written.

read_only_attestation.s3_access: GetObject only under disclosure/ and raw/. No object under raw/ or disclosure/protocol/ or disclosure/results/window_1/ was created, modified or deleted.

The successful rerun reported zero missing bodies and uniform bar coverage of 10,128 bars for every one of the 69 symbols. No code, parameter or environment was changed between the two invocations.
